fusions.name: Oculus Glare
fusions.desc: Fires a beam of light that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, its critical hit chance is 50% higher.

fusions.name: Chisel to the Mark
fusions.desc: Throws a chisel at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Carved Watcher
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, sets up a stone watcher for 12 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it fires on an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Twice
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 30% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
